## Build Failure Analysis

**Solution:** `BuildDiag.sln` — 3 projects: `Core` → `Services` → `Api`

---

### Root Cause (1 of 1): Missing `Newtonsoft.Json` NuGet package in `Services`

**Project:** `Services/Services.csproj`
**File:** `Services/UserService.cs`

| Error | Location | Message |
|-------|----------|---------|
| CS0246 | Line 2, Col 7 | `'Newtonsoft'` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | Line 3, Col 7 | `'Newtonsoft'` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | Line 22, Col 19 | `'JObject'` type not found |

`UserService.cs` has `using Newtonsoft.Json` / `using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq` directives and uses `JObject`, but the `Services.csproj` has **no PackageReference for `Newtonsoft.Json`** — it only references the `Core` project.

### Cascading Failure

**Project:** `Api/Api.csproj` — **no errors of its own**, but its build was skipped (`"Target 'Build' skipped. Previously built unsuccessfully."`) because its dependency `Services` failed to compile.

---

### Fix

Add the missing NuGet package to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <ProjectReference Include="..\Core\Core.csproj" />
</ItemGroup>
<!-- Add this ItemGroup -->
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

This single fix resolves all 3 compiler errors in `Services` and unblocks the `Api` project build.
